title: evaluation-manifest-v1
description: Documentation schema for the TOML task manifest. Every path is relative to the directory holding the manifest, must stay inside it, and must live outside the read-only baseline.

prompt.description: The task prompt file; copied outside the workspace and passed as --prompt-file.

baseline.description: Read-only baseline tree; every repeat is a fresh copy of it.

gold_overlay.description: Gold patch expressed as a file overlay so no external patch tool is required.

error_overlay.description: Optional wrong implementation that the target oracle must reject.

target_oracle.description: Script run outside the workspace with the candidate workspace as argv[1]. Exit 0 passes, exit 1 fails, any other code is a harness oracle error.

regression_oracle.description: Script proving pre-existing behaviour survived; same contract as target_oracle.

allowed_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths the agent may change.

forbidden_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths whose modification blocks strict success.

commands.description: Exact command and cwd pairs; the generated command-policy-v1 file matches them literally.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative directory that must already exist in the baseline.
